local_archive_search.scope: Exact-name/identifier search, not proof no conceptually related mechanism exists.

paper.title: World4Scorer: Outcome-Grounded World Modeling for Autonomous Driving

native_path.finding: Ego pose/velocity/acceleration/driving command (plus route target for B2D) form ego_token; it enters learned trajectory tokens before scene decoding and generation of 64 candidate 4s trajectories.
Candidate coordinates are embedded; SharedFuturePredictor consumes the full candidate-token pool and camera scene features. The future-visual training readout precedes ego_token addition.
ego_token is added to predicted states before six score heads. Weighted log/sigmoid aggregation followed by argmax selects a trajectory. This is actual native consumption of learned predictions.
B2D gets simulator ego state and the route point, invokes the model, adds a route-alignment bonus, selects a trajectory, then tracks it with PID and a stationary-creep rule.

goal_route_boundary.decision: NO_GO for an unchanged-native Goal-only physical-forecast intervention
goal_route_boundary.finding: With images and the full candidate trajectory bank fixed, the inspected future_predictor call has no explicit route/Goal/ego-status input. Changing route in normal forward changes generator inputs and downstream scores; B2D also changes explicit route re-ranking. Route progress and direction utility legitimately depend on route.
goal_route_boundary.added_interface_limit: Keeping original candidates and objective while injecting an alternative route only into selected scoring terms would be a researcher-added branch-specific writer, not the released native API. Changing scoring ego_token is not evidence of visual future prediction corruption.

distinct_source_fact.finding: Forecast states use native self-attention across candidate tokens before scene cross-attention. This is not a candidate-isolated forecasting implementation. Source establishes possible computational dependence only, not a ranking effect or task harm.

released_resources.local_model_health: Unmeasured; no weight download, loading or forward execution.

execution_resources.navsim: Requires Python3.9, Torch2.1.2/Torchvision0.16.2, nuPlan/NAVSIM dependencies, DINOv2 ViT-S/14 reg4 weights, OpenScene sensor/log data, maps and independent metric cache. No local task/assets qualification was performed.
execution_resources.navsim_outcomes: Official non-reactive evaluation uses LQR/kinematic-bicycle ego replay against cached traffic and maps. These independent simulator outcomes are stronger than learned predicted scores but are not reactive closed-loop driving harm.
execution_resources.bench2drive: An executable evaluator entry is published, requiring CARLA0.9.15 and Bench2Drive leaderboard/scenario_runner/routes. Checkpoint is strict-loaded on CUDA. Closed-loop collisions/cost can be evaluated after that separate setup; availability and latency here are unmeasured.
execution_resources.author_reported_compute: Paper Appendix A.3 reports 106.5ms FP32 batch-one forward on A100; generation/scoring1.4ms. Appendix A.2 reports14GiB peak at batch32 on24GB A30. These are author results, not local measurements or guaranteed CARLA-inclusive resource bounds.
execution_resources.cube_alternative: Released983061B outcome head attaches to LeWM get_cost; it consumes predicted terminal state and goal embedding. Config uses OGBench-Cube expert-start goals, H5/actionblock5 and50-step budget. Requires separate quentinll/lewm-cube weights, dataset stats and stable-worldmodel0.1.1; not the driving WM and not a Goal-in-forecast discovery.

native_count_and_permutation.finding: Default generation uses64 learned initial embeddings and64 output proposals. Predictor and heads accept runtime N; training invokes the shared predictor with one logged trajectory and16 bank candidates as well as generated64. In eval, with proposal tensors fixed, the scorer has no candidate-index position encoding: full-pool permutation should permute states/scores mathematically. Subdivision or unequal duplication changes self-attention context and is not equivalent. Finite-precision equality and tie behavior are not tested.

legitimate_context_confound.finding: The prediction trunk receives camera scene features and encoded candidate coordinates, not direct ego speed/acceleration/driving-command/route. These quantities influence the candidate generator, so the generated pool can indirectly encode missing physical and task context. Heads additionally receive ego_token after the predictor. Pool dependence therefore does not itself establish an irrelevant-information defect.

prediction_semantics.finding: The driving predictor produces a256D latent trained by candidate outcome losses. Only the logged executed query has an auxiliary384D front-camera DINO feature target2s ahead. Six pointwise heads read utility sub-scores; this is not an explicitly decoded physical future BEV/occupancy. Agent/area auxiliary outputs are training-only and B2D config disables them; BEV heads are unimplemented.

writer_boundary.finding: Released DrivoRModel.forward takes sensor/ego features and internally generates proposals. No external proposal or anchor writer is present in this inspected inference path. Reassembling pos_embed/future_predictor inputs or freezing the selectable bank while changing forecast-pool multiplicities is a new researcher-controlled component interface. No deployed attacker permission is claimed.

additional_selection_confound.finding: B2D independently standardizes route-agreement over the candidate pool and scales it by the learned-score standard deviation. Pool manipulation could affect this downstream term without any WM effect. A future causal experiment would need to separate these routes; the inspected source is not evidence that either causes harm.

single_scene_resource_gate.finding: Native inference can consume a batch-one image/ego tensor without future training targets or CLOVER bank. Construction first attempts DINOv2 initialization via timm pretrained_cfg_overlay using a local file; its broad exception fallback calls pretrained=True without that file and may fetch remote weights. Offline single-sample execution therefore needs the matching local backbone file or exact pretrained cache, as well as the released checkpoint. The non-truncated1822-entry code tree and HF file list contain no identified single-scene sensor-plus-ego-plus-independent-metric-cache evaluation bundle. Demos and training future embeddings cannot substitute for such a scene. A65802B b2d_shapes.npz exists but was not downloaded or treated as an evaluation scene. NAVSIM data/maps/cache or CARLA setup remain needed for real consequence evaluation; none was installed or qualified here.
single_scene_resource_gate.scope: Absence is limited to the inspected fixed code tree, HF file list and README; not a global claim about all author assets.

candidate_context_followup.decision: Candidate-context self-attention is a verified native resource fact, unlike candidate-isolated prior carriers. No security pilot is selected: intervention ownership is added, physical-context leakage is a serious alternative explanation, and independent true-scene utility is not locally ready. Do not infer harm or novelty from self-attention alone.
